entries.title: Revelation of John 10:1
segments: Then I saw another mighty angel, descending from Heaven. His robe was a cloud; over his head was the rainbow; his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire;

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:2
segments: in his hand he held a little book open. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land;

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:3
segments: and he cried in a loud voice like the roaring of a lion. At his cry the seven peals of thunder spoke, each with its own voice.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:4
segments: And, when they spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from Heaven say-- 'Keep secret what the seven peals of thunder said, and do not write it down.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:5
segments: Then the angel, whom I had seen standing on the sea and on the land, 'raised his right hand to the heavens,

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:6
segments: and swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, and the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it,' that time should cease to be.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:7
segments: Moreover at the time when the seventh angel shall speak, when he is ready to blow his blast, then the hidden purposes of God, of which he told the good news to his servants, the Prophets, are at once fulfilled.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:8
segments: Then came the voice which I had heard from Heaven. It spoke to me again, and said--'Go and take the book that is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:9
segments: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little book. And he said 'Take it, and eat it. It will be bitter to your stomach, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:10
segments: I took the little book out of the angel's hand 'and ate it, and, while in my mouth, it was like the sweetest honey'; but, when I had eaten it, it was bitter to my stomach.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:11
segments: And I was told--' You must prophesy again about men of many peoples, and nations, and languages, and about many kings.'
